placeResult.name: Punto Azul
placeResult.reviews_summary: Punto Azul is a beloved spot for many travelers, known for its flavorful Peruvian seafood, particularly the ceviche, which earns rave reviews. Despite common wait times of 15 to 40 minutes due to its popularity, the experience is often deemed worth it, enhanced by complimentary snacks or drinks. The attentive and friendly service receives consistent praise, though a few note occasional lapses. Guests appreciate the generous portions and cozy atmosphere, though some mention the music can be overly loud.
